criticalTruth: Runtime packages must not be physically moved merely to mirror ICM domains.
Current Vite browser build path can inject .env provider/service credentials into public browser state and is an S0 architectural risk.
The historical second-brain Vercel deployment and pauli-dashboard are sourced from separate repositories and are not canonical evidence for this repo's Mission Control.
The current real server control primitive is ops/pauli-control.
Upstream Pi has crossed package-scope and runtime-version boundaries; selective harvesting is safer than wholesale merge.
